rationale: dual_domain_bilateral_supervised-claude-agentic: proj_n_bf=1, img_n_bf=3, proj_kernel=3, proj_sx=0.01, proj_sy=0.3, proj_sr=0.0005, img_kernel=5, img_sx=0.5, img_sy=0.5, img_sr=0.02, lr=0.005, epochs=24, batch_size=1, val_chunk=1, train_n=200, val_n=214, grad_clip=1.0, lambda_neg=1.0, seed=42, rationale=ITER-2 (search-20260619-01, corrected 214-slice/321px-FOV metric). ONE KNOB: epochs 8->24 (3x). All else identical to iter-1 (proj_n_bf=1, img_n_bf=3 -> 12 trainable params unchanged; 3*(proj_n_bf+img_n_bf)). SIX-BOX: (1) iter-1 = SSIM 0.919 / hr 0.0279 in elapsed 254s -- only ~21% of the 1200s (20-min) budget used; 12-param bilateral, lr=5e-3. (2) FAILURE MODE: high SSIM but near-zero hr because the calibrated RMSE-sensitive headroom metric does not credit the bilateral's smoothing (campaign note: SSIM rewards the BF blur, headroom does not). Critically, with only 12 params at lr=5e-3 and 8 epochs the supervised-MSE loss -- which IS RMSE-sensitive, unlike SSIM -- has had little chance to drive the scalar sigmas to their RMSE-optimal (less-smoothing) values: the run is UNDER-TRAINED (254s/1200s). (3) ONE KNOB: epochs 8->24. JUSTIFICATION vs the other candidate (img_n_bf up): adding image-domain bilateral DEPTH at the current loose img_sr=0.02 would smooth MORE, which keeps SSIM high but does NOT lift the RMSE-driven hr (more blur is the wrong direction for headroom); whereas more epochs lets the MSE objective itself pull the sigmas toward the RMSE optimum AND uses the idle ~950s budget. epochs is the cleaner lever for the hr deficit. (4) HYPOTHESIS: if epochs 8->24, then hr rises above 0.0279 (toward the dual_domain_supervised U-Net sibling's 0.276) because the 12 BF sigmas are under-trained at 8 epochs and the supervised-MSE gradient -- being RMSE-sensitive -- will sharpen them. FALSIFIER: if hr stays <=~0.03 (flat) at 24 epochs, the 12-param bilateral is at its CAPACITY ceiling on the 2304-view Mayo FBP (not an under-training problem), and iter-3 must instead add capacity (img_n_bf up) or attack the proj-domain over-smoothing (proj_sr) -- epochs is then exhausted. (5) BUDGET: HARD 20-min train+score. iter-1 ran 8 epochs + 214-slice per-sample val + figure in 254s; per-step cost is dominated by the SHARED 2304-view FBP adjoint, not the 12 BF params, so 24 epochs ~= 3x train ~= 8 epochs*3 plus the single fixed val pass: est ~600-760s << 1200s. Comfortably inside the 30-min sbatch wall. val_n=214 KEPT (NOT reduced), grad_clip=1.0 KEPT. (6) Loop continues -- no control returned. HARD-WIRED (unchanged from iter-1): staged_canonical data, v3 mayo_ldct_fitted geometry, per-sample-ps (mayo_per_sample_setup/_fbp, per-sample pipe.R_full swap), bg_target=truth, val=ALL 214 L277 slices under the 321px detector-geometry FOV (evaluate_calibrated default for AGENT4CT_DATASET=mayo_ldct_2d; NO fov= override).
